baseline.interpretation: Single generic massing extrusion with no validated windows, floor differentiation, entrances, balconies, or roof silhouette.

changes: Kept the existing asset ID, scene, exported collection, local campus coordinate frame, center, and long-axis orientation.
Replaced estimated envelope and vertical scale with the proposed 2014 A105 floor-plan shell dimensions and A100 64 ft overall height; modeled five total levels.
Built a limestone ground-level plinth and four upper brick levels with floor bands, windows, selected balconies, ground-floor glazing, and an A200/A201-inspired hipped/gabled roof silhouette.
Used procedural materials and generated mesh geometry; no external textures or linked libraries.
Added preview-only ground plane, camera, and light outside the exported asset collection.

identity_and_use: 2014 county-hosted final detailed plan set for 225 Northwestern Avenue
source_support.footprint: A105 provides dimensioned first-floor and upper-floor shell rectangles. A100 labels 8,936 sf building coverage and the plan geometry includes small offsets/recesses. These are proposed-design dimensions, not survey/as-built measurements. A state building-footprints query found no target polygon.
source_support.position_and_orientation: The best geocoder match is an IDSI point-address candidate linked to the current parcel listed as 225 Northwestern Avenue. A100 north arrow and site layout support the retained long north-south orientation. Parcel comparison confirms plausible placement but not an exact building centroid or wall edge.
source_support.height_floors_roof: A100 explicitly gives five stories and 64 ft overall height. A200/A201 give floor finish levels through 47 ft 2 3/8 in, truss bearing at 56 ft 2 3/4 in, and a hip/gable roof silhouette. Gable positions and facade rhythm are interpreted from the drawings.
source_support.facade: A200/A201 show brick and stone veneer, siding fields, balconies, repeated openings, ground-floor storefront/garage bays, and awnings. Individual opening/bay dimensions and final as-built details remain reconstructed.
source_support.orthophoto: Current imagery corroborates the long north-south roof orientation and broad massing. The manual roof-edge measurement is not used as a wall footprint because shadow and adjacent features obscure edges.

validation.result: Rebuild/reopen checks pass for the expected asset collection, procedural materials, local transforms, and portability. Independent review r2 passed at 8.55/10. The first-floor shell matches A105 within 0.00002 m; the upper shell is 2 in longer north-south than A105 because the graded model reuses the ground-shell length.

unresolved_uncertainty: The 2014 drawings are proposed design documents rather than as-built or survey drawings; exact built shell, revisions, and setbacks may vary.
No directly matching surveyed building-footprint polygon was found. A100/A105 plan geometry is therefore the best available source for intended shell dimensions.

The IDSI point-address and parcel support plausible placement but do not establish a surveyed building centroid or wall line. Under the documented modular conversion, the model ground shell is within the generalized parcel; alternative approximations differ by a few tenths of a meter.

The first-floor rectangular shell matches A105 within 0.00002 m. The upper-shell width matches within rounding, but its north-south length is 0.0508 m (2 in) longer than A105 because the graded model uses the ground-floor length for upper levels.
Orthophoto roof dimensions remain approximate and differ from plan shell dimensions because visible roof edge is not structural wall footprint and shadows/nearby features obscure edges.
Facade zones, entrances/storefronts, opening and balcony stationing, and roof intersections are simplified readings of A200/A201 rather than exact elevation tracing.
